Help is the full manual, at the bottom of the left menu.
Search it for whatever screen you are stuck on and you get step-by-step instructions with pictures.
If the answer is not there, send us a question from the same screen — it comes through with your account attached, so we can see what you were looking at instead of asking you to describe it.
We would much rather hear from you early than find out weeks later that something has not been working.
